ThingDef.label: MMF40
ThingDef.description: Large caliber anti-material rifle. Equipped with a high-powered scope for sniping at long range. It is powerful enough to penetrate armored vehicles, but the recoil is moderate, making it very easy to use.It is widely deployed by EDF sniper units.

ThingDef.label: MMF43
ThingDef.description: This is the upper version of the MMF series, with all performance enhancements in order. It is a legitimate evolutionary version, with a high level of ease of handling inherited.

ThingDef.label: MMF100
ThingDef.description: The latest in the MMF series. The range of this model is almost unchanged from the previous model, but other performance features have been improved across the board, making it a very easy-to-handle sniper rifle.

ThingDef.label: MMF200
ThingDef.description: This is the final model of the MMF series. All the performance has been improved, and the power is now equivalent to that of a cannon. In particular, the bullet's velocity has been remarkably improved, and even from a long distance it can now land a bullet instantly.

ThingDef.label: Hercules
ThingDef.description: Sniper rifle with the highest versatility. It is as powerful as a tank gun, yet can fire a certain amount of rapid fire, and is said to be able to get through most battlefields with just one of these rifles.

ThingDef.label: Lysander
ThingDef.description: This is a large objective rifle that uses large-caliber bullets. Its power is far greater than that of the MMF series of the same level, and the impact force that the bullets accompany is also incomparable. However, it has a large recoil and is inferior in terms of rapid-fire capability.

ThingDef.label: Lysander2
ThingDef.description: Upper version with improvements to Lysander. The bullet's power and initial velocity have been improved, making it easier to handle, and it has the longest range of any weapon in the series.

ThingDef.label: LysanderF
ThingDef.description: The latest Lysander. The bullet's power and initial velocity have been further improved, and its destructive power, originally comparable to that of a tank gun, has been refined. However, due to its complicated structure, only a small number have been deployed.

ThingDef.label: LysanderZ
ThingDef.description: Lysander of the final battle specifications. It incorporates electromagnetic acceleration in its firing mechanism, and has tremendous power that exceeds that of the F-type. It is an extremely powerful weapon, but because of its incredibly complex internal structure, only a few of them are deployed per division.

ThingDef.label: Stringer
ThingDef.description: This sniper rifle uses large-caliber AP rounds and is almost like a cannon. It has greater power than the Lysander and penetrates through thick armor with ease, and is used as a trump card for sniping important targets. However, due to its structural problem of only being able to load one shot at a time, it is not capable of continuous fire.

ThingDef.label: StringerJ3
ThingDef.description: Improved version of the Stringer sniper rifle. It has even higher power and penetration.

ThingDef.label: StringerJ9
ThingDef.description: Stringer-type sniper rifle with final battle specifications. It boasts top-class firepower as an EDF infantry firearm, with ship's gun-level power and enough penetration power to penetrate even the hull armor of a starship. Due to the complexity of its structure, it is produced and deployed in very small numbers.

ThingDef.label: KFF50
ThingDef.description: Large caliber anti-material rifle. Equipped with a high-powered scope for sniping at long range. It is powerful enough to penetrate armored vehicles, but the recoil is moderate, making it very easy to use.

ThingDef.label: KFF51
ThingDef.description: Upper version of KFF50. Most of the performance has been enhanced and it is very easy to handle.

ThingDef.label: KFF60RE
ThingDef.description: The latest in the KFF series. All performances have been raised to the highest level, and the ease of handling common to the series has been inherited.

ThingDef.label: KFF70
ThingDef.description: This is the final battle specification of the KFF series. It is a masterpiece that meets the highest standards of performance required of a sniper rifle.A small number of them are deployed in the elite sniper units of the EDF.

ThingDef.label: LysanderZF
ThingDef.description: It is a Lysander sniper rifle that has been improved for ultimate performance beyond the final operational specification Z-type. It has become a monster capable of semi-automatic firing of ship's gun level destructive power.

ThingDef.label: MR98Fang
ThingDef.description: An almost cannon-like rifle that uses large-caliber ammunition. Specializing in power and penetration, it blows away even heavily armored opponents.

ThingDef.label: MR99Fang
ThingDef.description: A new model of the Fang-type sniper rifle. It has enhanced power and range, making it even more specialized for sniping important targets.

ThingDef.label: MR100Fang
ThingDef.description: Final battle specifications of the Fang-type sniper rifle. The range is almost the same as the previous model, but the power and penetration have been enhanced to the highest level.

ThingDef.label: Planet Sniper Cannon
ThingDef.description: It is a state-of-the-art personal heavy artillery gun and is one of the most powerful firearms that can be handled by an infantry unit. It has extremely high penetrating power and a monster level of power, but it also has tremendous recoil, and after firing, the user is left unprotected for a long period of time to withstand the recoil.

ThingDef.label: Planet Super Cannon
ThingDef.description: This new weapon is an even larger caliber version of the Planet Sniper Cannon. It boasts tremendous power that can change the course of a war, and its sighting time has been shortened by improving details. However, the tremendous recoil is virtually unchanged, leaving the user unprotected for an extended period of time after firing.
